rawInput:
Uber + Airbnb Hybrid

Build a platform where:

users can book stays
users can also book rides
hosts manage properties
drivers manage vehicles
dynamic pricing exists
real-time tracking exists
wallet/payment/refund system exists

1.primary_goal: A unified platform that enables users to book accommodations and rides, while allowing hosts to manage properties and drivers to manage vehicles, with dynamic pricing, real-time tracking, and an integrated wallet and payment system.
features: Property listing and booking for stays
Host dashboard for managing properties (availability, pricing, bookings)
Driver dashboard for managing vehicles and ride requests
Dynamic pricing engine for stays and rides based on demand, time, and location
In-app wallet system for storing funds
Secure payment processing (credit/debit cards, digital wallets)
User and host/driver rating and review system
Push notifications for booking confirmations, ride updates, and promotions
Search and filtering for properties and rides by location, price, availability
constraints: Must comply with local transportation and hospitality regulations
Must support PCI-DSS compliance for payment processing
Must ensure data privacy in accordance with GDPR or equivalent regulations
Must be responsive across mobile and web platforms
Must handle high concurrency during peak booking times
Must validate host property and driver vehicle documentation
integrations: Maps and geolocation API (e.g., Google Maps, Mapbox)
Cloud storage for property and vehicle media (e.g., AWS S3)
